caption: The drawing depicts a square textile or embroidery pattern with a beige background, bordered by a thin red line with a green vine and red flowers weaving along the edges. The central part of the design is dominated by a green-bordered diamond shape, inside which is a green floral urn with red, yellow, and orange flowers and green leaves symmetrically arranged around it. Surrounding the diamond, the beige field contains circular arrangements of small red flowers connected by green stems and leaves, and four large floral bouquets—one in each corner—shown in green urns, each with variations of red, blue, and green flowers and leaves. Scattered throughout the background are small red and blue flower motifs and green leaf clusters, filling the space evenly. At the top and bottom edges, there are additional ornate urn shapes containing floral displays, particularly notable in the middle of the top and bottom edges, echoing the central diamond motif. The composition is symmetrical overall, with a repetitive use of floral and botanical elements in green, red, blue, and yellow on the beige ground.
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
